Rejected: (a) am→is → killed: first person performs. Read aloud: BY-mea-sured AND-un-MEA-sured-MODES … SO in-TRUST su-PREME free-DOM should-GO.

lines: By measured and unmeasured modes — bondage, freedom — contemplating —
Bhairava I am — so in trust supreme freedom should go.
